message.content: {"draft":"Single-pass row mean. Pick BLOCK=next_pow2(N) so one masked load covers the row; sum in FP32, divide by actual N, store scalar.","plan":"Host: assert, alloc out, BLOCK=triton.next_power_of_2(width). Kernel: one masked load, to fp32, tl.sum, /N, store. No loop, no extra passes.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _row_mean_kernel(","    X,","    Y,","    stride,","    N,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","):","    row = tl.program_id(0)","    X += row * stride","    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = cols < N","    a = tl.load(X + cols, mask=mask, other=0.).to(tl.float32)","    total = tl.sum(a, axis=0)","    mean = total / N","    tl.store(Y + row, mean)","","","def run(x):","    assert x.is_cuda","    assert x.dim() == 2","    assert x.is_contiguous()","    rows, width = x.shape","    out = torch.empty((rows,), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)","    if rows == 0 or width == 0:","        return out","    BLOCK_SIZE = triton.next_power_of_2(width)","    grid = (rows,)","    _row_mean_kernel[grid](x, out, width, width, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)","    return out"]}
